card.title: Quality & Compliance Senior Manager
card.description:
**About the Role:**

As a CBRE Quality and Compliance Sr. Manager, you will be responsible for supervising the team that supports quality assurance and quality control deliverables for large and high-profile clients.

This job is part of the Contract Quality Management job function. They are responsible for managing the delivery of contractual services to ensure requirements are fulfilled.

 

**What You’ll Do:**

* Provide formal supervision to employees. Monitor the training and development of staff. Conduct performance evaluations and coaching. Oversee the recruiting and hiring of new employees.
* Coordinate and manage the team's daily activities. Establish work schedules, assign tasks, and cross-train staff. Set and track staff and department deadlines. Mentor and coach as needed.
* Execute both company and confidential client compliance programs and participate in continuous improvement objectives.
* Create initiatives and communicate issues across the functional areas. Report compliance status to key stakeholders and sr. management regularly.
* Manage the execution and evaluate the success of the quality-of-service initiatives for non-regulated services.
* Report Compliance (among other quality and business metrics) status to the client during review meetings; appropriately escalates and notifies CBRE and client management of quality and compliance issues.
* Oversee the inspection readiness program for the site. Manage audits as well as serve as the primary quality representative for operations.
* Apply a broad knowledge of the business, own discipline, and how own discipline integrates with others to achieve team and departmental objectives.
* Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE values. Influence others to adopt a different point of view while being guided by policies and departmental plans.
* Identify and solve technical and operational problems of complexity.
* Understand and recognize the broader impact across the department.
* Improve and change existing methods, processes, and standards within job discipline.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Bachelor's Degree preferred with 5 - 8 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered.
* Experience in the areas of staffing, selection, training, development, coaching, mentoring, measuring, appraising, and rewarding performance and retention is preferred.
* Ability to lead the exchange of sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations and handle problems.
* Leadership skills to motivate the team to achieve broad operational targets with impacts on own job discipline, multiple job disciplines, and department.
* In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Extensive organizational skills and an advanced inquisitive mindset.

***Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.***

**Why CBRE?**

When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants.

**AI Use Disclosure**

We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills, and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.

CBRE carefully considers multiple factors to determine compensation, including a candidate’s education, training, and experience. The minimum salary for the position is $160,000 annually and the maximum salary for the position is $180,000 annually. The compensation that is offered to a successful candidate will depend on the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience. Successful candidates will also be eligible for a discretionary bonus based on CBRE’s applicable benefit program. This role will provide the following benefits: 401(K), Dental insurance, Health insurance, Life insurance, and Vision insurance.

 **Equal Employment Opportunity:** CBRE has a long-standing commitment to providing equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status, political belief, or any other basis protected by applicable law. 
 
**Candidate Accommodations:** CBRE values the differences of all current and prospective employees and recognizes how every employee contributes to our company’s success. CBRE provides reasonable accommodations in job application procedures for individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance due to a disability in the application or recruitment process, please submit a request via email at recruitingaccommodations@cbre.com or via telephone at +1 866 225 3099 (U.S.) and +1 866 388 4346 (Canada).

card.title: Senior Consultant, Quality (VP-Level)
card.description:
This individual will serve as an integral consultant with exposure to multiple facets of business operations. The **Senior Consultant, Quality** will be responsible for helping to set strategic direction and operational oversight of the quality function addressing all aspects of GXP compliance.This consultant ensures all internal processes and external partnerships strictly adhere to global regulatory standards, including FDA, EMA, and ICH guidelines.

**This role can be up to 10 hours per week to start.**

 

Elicio (ELTX) is a growing organization based out of the Seaport area of Boston, Massachusetts with additional staff functioning in a virtual based environment from the Greater Boston area and throughout the United States.

 

**Key Responsibilities Include**

 

* **Strategic Leadership:**Develop and execute a comprehensive quality and compliance vision that aligns with the company’s clinical and commercial objectives.
* **Quality Management System (QMS):**Design, implement, and maintain a robust QMS—including document control, change management, and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) systems—that scales with the company's growth.
* **GxP Compliance Oversight:**Ensure full compliance across all GxP areas, including Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Good Clinical Practices (GCP), and Good Laboratory Practices (GLP).
* **Regulatory Interaction:**Serve as the primary liaison for regulatory health authorities during inspections and audits; lead the strategy for inspection readiness.
* **External Partner Management:**Oversee quality at external vendors, including contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs) and clinical research organizations (CROs), ensuring consistent quality standards and negotiating quality agreements.
* **Product Disposition:**Hold ultimate accountability for the review and release (disposition) of raw materials, intermediates, and final drug products for both clinical trials and commercial sale.
* **Culture & Talent:**Build and mentor a high-performing quality organization while championing a "Quality First" culture across all departments.

 

**Education & Professional Experience**

 

* Bachelor’s degree in a scientific or technical discipline (e.g., Biology, Chemistry, Pharmacy) is required. An advanced degree (MS, PhD, or MBA) is strongly preferred.
* 15+ years of progressive leadership in quality within the biotech or pharmaceutical industry.
* Deep knowledge of global regulatory frameworks (FDA 21 CFR Part 11, 210/211, and ISO standards) and experience in biologics or small molecule manufacturing, and parenteral products. Experience with peptide-based vaccines is a plus.
* Proven track record of managing outsourced operations successfully leading organizations through regulatory inspections and commercial product launches.
* Must thrive in a fast-paced innovative start-up environment.
* Exceptional communication and negotiation skills for interacting with executive teams and regulatory agencies.
* Strong risk management and analytical problem-solving abilities.
* Strategic thinking with a "hands-on" approach to building quality organizations and quality systems.

 

**Working Model**

**Weekly hours:** This role can be up to 10 hours per week to start. It may increase or decrease over time.

**Working Conditions:** Busy home office/office/laboratory environment with frequent deadlines and interruptions.

**Travel:** Travel may be required to the Company’s headquarters a few times per year, if necessary.

**Physical Requirements:** Subject to periods of sitting or standing, vision is required to monitor data.

**Work Location:** Hybrid preference but will consider remote

**About Elicio Therapeutics**

Elicio Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: ELTX) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company advancing a pipeline of novel lymph node-targeted immunotherapies for the treatment of some of the most aggressive cancers. By combining expertise in immunology and immunotherapy, Elicio is harnessing the natural power of the immune system with the AMP technology, which allows for therapeutic payloads to be delivered directly to the lymph nodes, with the goal of enhancing the immune system’s cancer-fighting capabilities. By targeting cancer immunotherapies to the core of the immune response, AMP aims to optimize the lymph nodes’ natural ability to educate, activate and amplify cancer-specific T cells, which are essential for recognizing and eliminating tumor cells. Engineered to synchronize immunity in these highly potent sites, AMP is built to enhance the magnitude, potency, quality and durability of the immune response to drive antitumor activity. The Company’s R&D pipeline includes off-the-shelf therapeutic cancer vaccines ELI-002, (targeting mKRAS-driven cancers) as well as ELI-007 and ELI-008 (targeting BRAF-driven cancers and p53 hotspot mutations, respectively). For more information, please visit www.elicio.com.

**About the Amphiphile Platform**

 

Elicio Therapeutics’ proprietary Amphiphile (“AMP”) platform delivers investigational immunotherapeutics directly to the “brain center” of the immune system – the lymph nodes. Elicio believes this site-specific delivery of disease-specific antigens, adjuvants and other immunomodulators may efficiently educate, activate, and amplify critical immune cells, potentially resulting in induction and persistence of potent adaptive immunity required to treat many diseases. In preclinical models, Elicio has observed lymph node-specific engagement driving therapeutic immune responses of increased magnitude, function and durability. Elicio believes our AMP lymph node-targeted approach will produce superior clinical benefits compared to immunotherapies that do not engage the lymph nodes based upon preclinical studies. Elicio’s AMP platform, originally developed at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology has broad potential in the cancer space to advance a number of development initiatives through internal activities, in-licensing arrangements or development collaborations and partnerships. The AMP platform has been shown to deliver immunotherapeutics directly to the lymph nodes by latching on to the protein albumin, found in the bloodstream, as it travels to lymphatic tissue. In preclinical models, Elicio has observed lymph node-specific engagement driving immune responses of increased magnitude, function and durability.

card.title: VP of Operations – Appliance
card.description:
**Vice President of Operations – Appliance Segment**
----------------------------------------------------

**Company:** SSW Advanced Technologies, LLC 
**Location:** REMOTE, with regular travel to plants in the U.S., Canada and Mexico 
**Travel:** Approximately 30–50% 
**Employment type:** Full-time, exempt

### **About the Role**

SSW Advanced Technologies is a leading manufacturer of engineered components for major appliance OEMs. We’re looking for a **Vice President of Operations** to lead our Appliance Segment, a multi-plant operation that makes wire, glass and component products for some of the best-known names in home appliances.

You’ll be accountable for the safety, quality, delivery and financial performance of our appliance plants across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. That includes:

* San Luis Potosí, MX; Sweetwater, TN; Vincennes, IN; Midland, ON; Clinton, IA & Madison, TN

This is a hands-on executive role for a leader who can set the strategy, build strong plant teams and deliver results for demanding OEM customers.

### **What You’ll Do**

* **Own segment performance:** Drive end-to-end results across all appliance plants against targets for safety, quality, delivery, cost and EBITDA.
* **Set the operations strategy:** Develop and execute a multi-year plan that supports growth, margin expansion and footprint optimization across U.S., Canada and Mexico operations.
* **Lead the customer relationship on operations:** Serve as the senior operations contact for appliance OEM customers, and meet or exceed scorecard goals for quality (PPM), on-time delivery, responsiveness and cost.
* **Deliver launches and changeovers:** Partner with Engineering, Quality and Sales so that capacity, tooling, customer qualification and ramp-up are ready on schedule.
* **Match capacity to demand:** Align production plans with OEM schedules, including seasonal and promotional volume swings, build-ahead requirements and short-notice changes.
* **Partner on supply chain:** Work closely with Supply Chain leadership on commodity exposure, supplier performance, alternate sourcing, inventory, premium freight and cross-border logistics.
* **Drive productivity and cost reduction:** Deliver annual plans that offset customer price-downs and inflation through Lean, automation, scrap reduction and labor efficiency.
* **Manage the numbers:** Build and manage the segment operating budget, capital plan and staffing plan. Hold plant leaders accountable to budget, and lead weekly forecast and commitment reviews.
* **Champion safety and compliance:** Build a zero-harm safety culture and fully implement our integrated Quality, Safety and Environmental management system, 5S and EHS standards.
* **Develop leaders:** Lead, coach and develop Plant and General Managers and operations leaders, and build bench strength and succession for critical roles.
* **Standardize how we run:** Establish common best practices, KPIs and daily, weekly and monthly operating rhythms across all plants.
* **Lead change:** Guide restructuring, footprint and transfer-of-work initiatives, including workforce planning.

### **What You Bring**

**Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Business Administration or a related field
* 10+ years of progressive operations leadership in manufacturing, including multi-plant responsibility
* A proven record of delivering cost reduction, successful launches and EBITDA improvement
* Strong P&L, budgeting and capital planning skills
* Executive-level communication and decision-making
* Fluent English

**Preferred:**

* Experience supplying major appliance OEMs or other high-volume OEM customers
* Background in metal forming, wire, glass, coating/finishing or assembly operations
* Experience leading operations in Mexico and managing cross-border supply chains
* MBA or master’s degree
* Lean or Six Sigma certification
* Spanish fluency (strongly preferred)

### **Your Team**

* **Direct reports:** Plant Managers, Operations Managers and Maintenance Managers across the Appliance Segment
* **Dotted-line partners:** Segment Quality, Engineering and EHS leaders

### **Work Environment**

Office and manufacturing plant environments, with regular travel between U.S., Canadian and Mexican facilities and to customer sites.

### **Why SSW**

* Lead a growing, multi-national segment with real influence on strategy and results
* Work directly with senior leadership in a hands-on, fast-moving environment
* Competitive salary, annual bonus and comprehensive benefits

*SSW Advanced Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.*
